markers.name: C677T
markers.description: Folate activation cofactor. Affects neurotransmitter synthesis (dopamine/serotonin), cardiovascular risk, and overall methylation efficiency.

markers.name: A1298C
markers.description: Secondary methylation cofactor bottleneck. Impacts BH4 synthesis, affecting nitric oxide production and neurotransmitters.

markers.name: Val158Met
markers.description: Affects prefrontal cortex dopamine levels. Val/Val clearing is fast (higher stress resilience, lower executive focus), Met/Met clearing is slow (higher focus, lower stress tolerance, slower estrogen metabolism).

markers.name: Taq1A
markers.description: Associated with reward deficiency syndrome, higher susceptibility to addictive behaviors, and altered response to dopaminergic agents.

markers.name: Val66Met
markers.description: Affects neuroplasticity, memory consolidation, and hippocampal volume. Associated with vulnerability to depression and anxiety.

markers.name: -1438A>G
markers.description: Linked to susceptibility for depression, anxiety, and altered response to SSRI medications.

markers.name: C112R (e4 marker)
markers.impact: ApoE epsilon 4 allele carrier (Alzheimer & cardiovascular risk)
markers.description: Crucial marker for lipid transport and neuronal repair. One or two copies of e4 (rs429358-C + rs7412-C) significantly increase risk of late-onset Alzheimer's and atherosclerosis.

markers.name: R158C (e2 marker)
markers.description: Associated with lower LDL cholesterol but higher risk of type III hyperlipoproteinemia when homozygous.

markers.name: R46L
markers.description: Loss-of-function variant leading to lower PCSK9 levels, resulting in increased LDL receptor recycle rate and ~30% reduction in cardiovascular disease risk.

markers.name: rs10455872
markers.description: Associated with significantly higher plasma Lp(a) levels and increased risk of coronary artery disease and aortic stenosis.

markers.name: Ile1891Met
markers.description: Associated with elevated Lp(a) and increased cardiovasculary disease risk, specifically showing sensitivity to aspirin therapy.

markers.name: Met235Thr
markers.description: Linked to elevated circulating angiotensinogen and higher predisposition to essential hypertension.

markers.name: I560S (*14)
markers.description: Dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase deficiency. Carriers of the C allele cannot safely metabolize fluorouracil/capecitabine chemotherapy, leading to life-threatening toxicity.

markers.name: c.1905+1G>A (*2A)
markers.description: Splice site mutation causing complete loss of DPYD enzyme activity. Homozygotes or compound heterozygotes experience profound toxicity from 5-FU.

markers.name: Arg144Cys (*2)
markers.description: Warfarin, phenytoin, and NSAID clearance bottleneck. Carriers require lower maintenance doses of warfarin to avoid bleeding risks.

markers.name: Ile359Leu (*3)
markers.description: Highly compromised CYP2C9 clearance rate. Extreme sensitivity to warfarin and standard doses of NSAIDs (celecoxib, ibuprofen).

markers.name: 681G>A (*2)
markers.description: Loss-of-function allele. Poor metabolizers fail to activate clopidogrel (Plavix), leading to increased risk of cardiovascular events post-stent placement.

markers.name: Val174Ala (*5)
markers.description: Decreased activity of OATP1B1 liver transporter. Causes elevated systemic concentrations of statins (simvastatin, atorvastatin), increasing skeletal muscle pain/myopathy risk.

markers.name: c.181T>G (p.Cys61Gly)
markers.description: Significantly increases lifetime risk of breast, ovarian, and prostate cancer. Requires clinical confirmatory sequencing.

markers.name: c.5266dupC (5382insC)
markers.description: Ashkenazi Jewish founder mutation. High penetrance breast and ovarian cancer risk allele.

markers.name: c.5946delT (6174delT)
markers.description: Founder mutation in BRCA2. Strongly associated with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndromes.

markers.name: C282Y
markers.description: Primary driver of hereditary hemochromatosis. Homozygotes are at risk of progressive iron overload in the liver, heart, and pancreas, manageable via therapeutic phlebotomy.

markers.name: H63D
markers.description: Contributes to mild iron overload, especially when inherited in combination with the C282Y allele (compound heterozygosity).

markers.name: Glu342Lys (PI*Z)
markers.impact: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency risk (Lung & Liver disease)
markers.description: Homozygous Z carriers have severely reduced AAT levels, predisposing them to early-onset emphysema (especially if smokers) and liver cirrhosis.

markers.name: rs9939609
markers.impact: Higher obesity predisposition and food cravings
markers.description: Alters expression of IRX3 and IRX5 genes. Associated with lower satiety levels, higher calorie intake, and greater preference for energy-dense foods.

markers.name: -13910C>T
markers.description: Homozygous C/C results in adult downregulation of lactase enzyme expression, leading to gut symptoms from dairy consumption.

markers.name: Glu504Lys
markers.impact: Alcohol flush reaction and esophageal cancer risk
markers.description: Lys504 carriers have highly compromised acetaldehyde dehydrogenase activity, causing build-up of toxic acetaldehyde after alcohol ingestion (flushing, nausea, tachycardia).

markers.name: W143X (Non-Secretor)
markers.impact: Altered B12 levels and norovirus resistance
markers.description: Non-secretor status (AA) prevents secretion of ABO blood group antigens into body fluids, providing absolute resistance to common norovirus strains but lower blood B12 levels.

markers.name: 1639G>A
markers.description: Major pharmacogenomic determinant of warfarin dose. AA carriers typically need substantially lower maintenance doses.

markers.name: -163C>A
markers.description: AA genotype associated with increased CYP1A2 activity and faster caffeine clearance; CC slows metabolism and may increase cardiovascular sensitivity to caffeine.

markers.name: -806C>T
markers.description: Increases CYP2C19 expression. Affects clopidogrel activation, PPI metabolism, and several psychiatric medications.

markers.name: *4 (splicing defect)
markers.description: Common loss-of-function allele affecting codeine, tramadol, tamoxifen, and many antidepressant/antipsychotic drugs.
Affects tacrolimus dosing and several CYP3A substrate medications. Important in transplant pharmacogenomics.

markers.name: T3111C
markers.description: Associated with evening chronotype tendencies and altered sleep-wake regulation.

markers.name: MTNR1B intronic
markers.impact: Melatonin receptor variant affecting glucose and sleep
markers.description: Linked to later melatonin onset, impaired glucose tolerance, and sleep timing shifts.

markers.name: LoF
markers.description: Rare loss-of-function variant associated with altered melatonin receptor activity and sleep/metabolic phenotypes.

markers.name: BsmI
markers.description: Influences vitamin D signaling, bone density, and immune modulation. Often evaluated alongside rs7975232 and rs731236.

markers.name: R620W
markers.description: One of the strongest common autoimmunity risk alleles in European ancestry populations.

markers.name: Thr92Ala
markers.description: Affects deiodinase-2 activity and may influence response to levothyroxine vs combination therapy.

markers.name: Heel BMD locus
markers.description: Genome-wide significant association with heel bone mineral density. Often intergenic; interpret with DXA/clinical bone health context, not gene name alone.

markers.name: Ala1330Val
markers.description: Wnt/LRP5 pathway variant linked to bone mineral density and fracture risk.

markers.name: BMD locus
markers.description: Associated with cortical bone mineral density and fracture susceptibility in large GWAS meta-analyses.

markers.name: Sp1 binding site
markers.impact: Collagen I expression and bone fragility
markers.description: Regulatory variant in COL1A1 affecting collagen production; relevant to bone and connective tissue integrity.
